title: Architecture-only control for candidate-axis response structure
kind: inference-only; no training; only aggregation weights differ
primary_statistic: orbit-shape agreement rho = (1/12) sum_m z1_m z2_m, z = within-unit z-score (population std) of s_m = median(disparity_initial[mask])
